messages:
lucy: Heads-up — onboarding a new LlamaX variant and seeing weird chat template breakage. Fast tokenizer loads but special tokens missing at runtime. Error from runtime: 
```
Error: Missing special token mapping: 'bos_token'
Requested field 'tokenizer_config.json' not found in model archive
```
Looks like HF repo only had `tokenizer.json` and `vocab.*`, no `tokenizer_config.json`. Anyone seen this exact failure? :eyes:

arjun: yup. Fast tokenizers sometimes pack everything into `tokenizer.json` but our conversion expects `tokenizer_config.json` for special token aliases (bos/eos/pad). If absent, the runtime tries to map and fails. Quick test: `AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(path, use_fast=False)`?

ben: tried that — `use_fast=False` (slow) loads and the chat flow is fine, but slow breaks streaming perf for the eval harness. So we need a deterministic fix for hosted/onboarding.

ciara: can we reconstruct `tokenizer_config.json` from `tokenizer.json`? Often `special_tokens_map` or `added_tokens` are buried under `model` key in the fast JSON. I wrote a small extractor before. Example snippet that worked: 
```
# pseudo
with open('tokenizer.json') as f:
  j = json.load(f)
specials = j.get('model', {}).get('special_tokens_map', {})
# write tokenizer_config.json with the token names
```

lucy: can you paste the extractor or open a PR? We need this in the HF->Redwood onboarding script.

ciara: pushing gist in a sec. main caveat: some tokenizers name tokens differently (e.g., `cls_token` vs `bos_token`) so we should normalize aliases. I'll include mapping logic.

arjun: also watch out for `tokenizer_config.json` that only contains `model_max_length` or `do_lower_case` — we specifically need `special_tokens_map`, `bos_token`, `eos_token`, `pad_token`, `unk_token`. If any are missing, fallback to deducing from `added_tokens` order is brittle.

ben: for this model, deducing gives wrong bos (it picked a newline token) which caused prompt truncation and regen failures on evals. We should add a unit test that checks that `decoded(tokenizer.bos_token_id)` equals expected marker for chat models.

tokenizer-bot: build-checker reported: converted artifact missing `tokenizer_config.json` for model `llama-x-1b-clip` during automated onboarding run 2026-03-18T14:07Z. Tagging @ciara for follow-up.

ciara: gist -> https://gist.github.com/ciara/tokenconfig-extract (short script + mapping table). PR incoming to `inference-model-tools` with tests. Planning to: 1) extract specials from tokenizer.json if present, 2) normalize alias names, 3) write tokenizer_config.json next to tokenizer.json, 4) add CI assertion in onboarding.

lucy: perfect. Also add a warning in the console if `tokenizer_config.json` is missing and we had to synthesize it — that will help debug future regressions. :white_check_mark:

arjun: one more thing — doc note for model owners: include both files in model archive when publishing to HF or set `fast_tokenizer=True` in config. That avoids surprises. I'll add a short blurb in the onboarding checklist.

ben: after CI + PR, I'll re-run quantization evals. If fast loads with generated tokenizer_config.json, we'll run A/B on perf/quality between original fast vs slow fallback.

lucy: awesome. Action items: ciara PR for extractor + tests, arjun update onboarding docs, ben run evals after merge. Tag me if you need model artifact access.

ciara: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference-model-tools/pull/512 — includes script, mapping table, and two unit tests (one for a known HF packed tokenizer, one for a case missing `bos`).

lucy: will review. Thanks all.
